topics.name: Apple acquiring F1 US broadcasting rights
topics.summary: Apple is trending toward winning F1 US rights for 2026+ at $120-150M/year vs ESPN's $90M bid; thesis is F1's younger, more female audience aligns better with Apple TV+ subscriber base than traditional ESPN cord-bundle audience.

topics.name: Meme stock resurgence season 2
topics.summary: Opendoor (+439% in a month), Krispy Kreme (+40%), Kohl's, GoPro (+57%), and others surging on social media retail momentum; options volume on Opendoor briefly exceeded NVIDIA; analysts see full-blown mania indicators but debate whether it rivals 2021 intensity.

topics.name: Amazon acquiring B (Bee) AI wearable
topics.summary: Amazon acquired the B bracelet startup that transcribes all ambient conversations and auto-generates to-do lists; raises privacy debate; device priced at $49.99; seen as Amazon's move back into personal AI assistant hardware.

topics.name: Meta neural wrist control interface
topics.summary: Meta published research on a generic non-invasive neuromotor wrist interface allowing users to control devices with finger/hand gestures via EMG signals; demoed for hosts; built on Control Labs acquisition.

topics.name: AI chip competition vs NVIDIA
topics.summary: Meta advancing Olympus GPU and new Project ARC chip on TSMC 2nm targeting 2027-2028; hyperscalers broadly trying to reduce NVIDIA dependency; XAI referencing Blackwell equivalents rather than committing to NVIDIA exclusively.

topics.name: Vanta $150M Series D
topics.summary: Vanta raised $150M at $4B pre/$4.5B post valuation; grew from SOC 2 automation wedge to broad trust management platform; expanding into security products, government FedRAMP 20x, and European market.

topics.name: AI in healthcare investment landscape
topics.summary: AI scribes seen as crowded (100+ companies); Lux Capital excited about clinical trial matching, regulatory writing, robotic surgery, and BCI; payers rapidly adopting clinical AI; OpenAI entering therapy and health via ChatGPT.

topics.name: PCB design and manufacturing automation
topics.summary: Diodes raised a16z Series A to automate circuit board design and manufacturing using LLMs and code-based schematics; aims to make US PCB manufacturing cost-competitive with China through AI and franchised assembly hubs.

topics.name: Building a company in France vs the US
topics.summary: Cala founder Elan described shutting down a profitable French food robotics company because French insolvency law severance costs exceeded available cash; now restarting in the US with leaner HQ structure and franchising model.

topics.name: US AI policy shift to growth and dominance
topics.summary: New federal AI action plan shifts posture from safety-first to growth and geopolitical competition; includes 90+ follow-on actions covering deregulation, fast-track permitting, export rules, DoD autonomous systems, NSF compute access, and open source R&D support.

topics.name: ARC AGI v3 human benchmark challenge
topics.summary: Intern Tyler competed on ARC AGI v3 leaderboard; achieved 576 moves (under 600 threshold) to make the leaderboard and win an iPhone; climbed to 5th place with 525 moves; goal is to beat number one at 511.

topics.name: Crypto treasury strategy saturation
topics.summary: Matt Levine noted the Bitcoin treasury trade is saturated; companies moving to Ethereum, Solana, Tron, BNB, Trump coin; satirized Quantum BioPharma buying $50K of GameStop as next evolution of the trend.

topics.name: MLS Apple TV deal backlash from GMs
topics.summary: MLS general managers say the Apple TV exclusivity deal is too much of a barrier for new fans and hurts growth; want more presence on linear TV like ABC, NBC, Fox.

topics.name: Sonos CEO change and product issues
topics.summary: Tom Conrad named permanent CEO after six months as interim; Sonos app still takes 90 seconds to load despite same hardware previously loading in 10 seconds; hosts speculate OpenAI could acquire Sonos at ~$1.3B market cap.

topics.name: AI wearables and privacy normalization
topics.summary: Discussion of societal shift from Google Glass backlash ('glasshole') to widespread acceptance of Meta Ray-Bans and ambient recording devices; B bracelet raises PHI and legal discovery concerns in healthcare context.

topics.name: F1 audience demographics driving streaming fit
topics.summary: F1 global fan survey of 100K respondents shows three in four new fans are female; Gen Z over-indexes on engagement; US fans stand out for growth, youth, and digital fluency; supports Apple TV+ fit over ESPN.

topics.name: Robotic food automation economics
topics.summary: Cala and Sweetgreen cited as only two companies to prove positive ROI on robotic kitchen installations; robotics food graveyard in US includes many well-funded failed attempts; Elan restarting with higher revenue-per-store target and franchise model.

topics.name: AI productivity and org design
topics.summary: Christina Cacioppo discussed Conway's Law in practice: ship your org chart; changing org chart is only real way to fight it; also noted AI enabling 15-minute product ideation loops vs prior 2-day design cycles.
